changelog:
- Initial release of hippocampus-subagent-memory skill.
- Enables isolated sub-agent memory in OpenClaw using scoped IDs.
- Prevents accidental memory leakage across sibling/parent contexts.
- Supports bounded merge-back and explicit import from child to parent.
- Includes guidance for namespace management and session linkage.
summary: Isolate and coordinate sub-agent memory in OpenClaw with Hippocampus using scoped IDs, bounded merge-back, and explicit cross-agent imports.
